what: A layered Photoshop file of a frame needs export_psd in the export toolset, which a core-only session learns of only from the instructions map.
text: instructions map: export (PSD, PNGs with alpha); export_psd description (`dryRun` lists the layers)
source: spec 19 TL-112: delivery tools added by the interchange stream, measured into +export at integration 2
prompt: Send the frame at 5 seconds to Photoshop as a layered PSD; just tell me what layers it would have first.

what: A transparent PNG of a frame is export_frame {alpha: true}; without alpha its PNG is opaque.
text: export_frame description ("A transparent PNG needs `alpha: true`") and its alpha parameter; instructions map: export (PNGs with alpha)
source: spec 19 TL-114; AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: export_alpha merged into export_frame
prompt: Export the frame at 2 seconds as a PNG with a transparent background.

what: Export Title: one clip alone, trimmed with a margin so its glow is kept, is export_frame {alpha, clipIds, trimMarginPx}.
text: export_frame details and its clipIds and trimMarginPx parameters
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: export_alpha merged into export_frame
prompt: Export only the title as a transparent PNG sequence of its first two seconds, cropped to the title with room for its glow.

what: An ordinary still stays an opaque export_frame: no alpha, no PSD.
text: export_frame alpha parameter and export_psd description vs an opaque still
prompt: Export the frame at 5 seconds as a JPEG into {{cwd}}.

what: A broadcast-legal check of a frame is color_gamut_check in the color toolset.
text: color_gamut_check description; color toolset; guide topic delivery
source: spec 19 TL-116: check_gamut, measured into +color at integration 2; AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: renamed color_gamut_check
prompt: Check whether the frame at 3 seconds has colours that are illegal for Rec. 709 broadcast.

what: Reading levels and clipping is the scopes, not the gamut check.
prompt: Read the waveform of the frame at 3 seconds: are the highlights clipping at 100 %?

what: Photoshop layer styles become title looks through import_layer_styles, and what did not map is reported to the user.
text: import_layer_styles description (a report of what each style approximates)
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: import_layer_styles had no case
prompt: Import the Photoshop layer styles in {{cwd}}/styles/brand.asl as title looks, and tell me what did not carry over.

what: Cutting a still logo into its letters is image_split, not a cut in time.
text: image_split description ("A cut in time: `split_at`"); graphics toolset
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: split_image renamed image_split, had no case
prompt: Split the logo image on V2 into its separate letters so I can animate each one.

what: A cut in time stays split_at, even with a still on the timeline.
prompt: Split the clip on V1 at 10 seconds.
